exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.tip: Keep shoulder blades back and lower the weight under control.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.tip: Keep ribs down and do not force the handles too low.

exercises.name: Pec Deck
exercises.tip: Lead with your elbows and avoid shrugging.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pressdown
exercises.tip: Keep elbows close to your sides.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.tip: Pull toward the upper chest without leaning far back.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.tip: Finish with elbows back, not shoulders shrugged.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Machine
exercises.tip: Use a light weight and move with control.

exercises.name: Machine or Cable Curl
exercises.tip: Keep upper arms still.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.tip: Keep your lower back supported and control the depth.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.tip: Pause briefly when the knees are bent.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.tip: Do not swing the weight.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
exercises.tip: Use a full comfortable range.

exercises.name: Incline Machine Press
exercises.tip: Keep shoulder blades supported.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.tip: Pull elbows toward your back pockets.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.tip: Use light weight and stop around shoulder height.

exercises.name: Cable Arms Superset
exercises.tip: Move slowly and keep the joints comfortable.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat or Leg Press
exercises.tip: Choose the option that feels best on your joints.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.tip: Use the same setup each week.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.tip: Keep the movement controlled.

exercises.name: Treadmill Walk
exercises.tip: Use a pace you can maintain.
